4e7eaed04ae4b725.column_purpose: Disease complications/comorbid events: CNS lupus, brain infarction, AMI, PH (pulmonary hypertension), thrombocytopenia, DVT, thrombophlebitis, abortion, etc. Mostly null (no complication).

9a211928dc767179.column_purpose: Patient date of birth (all values 1981-1999, consistent with a pediatric cohort).
